snippet.title: Ballroom Banter Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDigi XP1 trailer for Ballroom Banter, a free and super fun card game! Available for download now!
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ballroom-banter/id1562189556
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MassDiGI.Cake
Work your way through the hierarchy of a high society masquerade ball. Gossip and discuss a path through various social circles, powering up your deck of social cards!

2021
